selection: All screened code and documentation extensions; all screened JSON reports with audit/result/decision/protocol/readiness/checkpoint/manifest/completion/cost/summary/stop/proof/status/resume/gate/inventory/lock/ack in filename and <=1MiB. Outcome-independent selection. Exact bytes; no scientific reruns.
limitations: NOT a complete raw binary/checkpoint/capsule/journal backup. Large raw files, non-selected arrays and per-record files remain local. Credentials, environment directories and downloaded base caches excluded. Core snapshot files may also be directly available outside these archives.
inventory_phase_note: Inventory labels were written before Git upload; the branch commit and local remote-readback receipt establish publication.
